Garden Maintenance in the Blue Mountains

Regular or one-off garden maintenance — pruning, hedge trimming and seasonal tidy-ups that keep your garden looking its best.

A great garden needs upkeep. We take care of the regular jobs — pruning, hedge trimming, edging and seasonal clean-ups — on a schedule that suits you, or as a one-off tidy.

Ideal for busy owners, rentals and holiday homes that need to stay presentable year round.

What’s included

  • Pruning and shaping
  • Hedge and shrub trimming
  • Seasonal clean-ups
  • Edging and general tidy-ups
  • One-off or scheduled visits
  • Green waste removed

Why Blue Mountains Landscapers

We build for Mountains conditions every day — slope, sandstone, cold and bushfire zones. You get one accountable local crew, a clear fixed quote, and work built to last. Right now every job comes with 20% off for spring and summer.
